description: A total of 86 horses changed hands during the one-day auction for $7,913,000, including post-ring sales. The average price was down slightly to $92,012 and the median increased 31% to $52,500. Only one horse failed to meet its reserve.

description: Video replays of workouts on 1/ST TV published over the last decade, have been announced as ending.

description: A lawsuit filed against multiple parties over an alleged wrongful scratch of White Abarrio from a 2025 Breeders' Cup race has been dismissed with prejudice.

title_en: Longtime Racing Office Executive Polzin Retires
description: When the 24th season of Thoroughbred and Quarter Horse racing at Horseshoe Indianapolis comes to a close Nov. 13, it will also mark the end of a stellar career for director of racing Chris Polzin.

title_en: Heartwood Farm Buys Midway Memories for $320K
description: The Keeneland November Horses of Racing Age Sale is known as a marketplace for racehorses. But a 4-year-old filly, Midway Memories (Hip 4031), also drew interest Nov. 12 during the single-session sale for her potential as a broodmare.

title_en: Renowned Cartoonist Peb Dies at 99 in New Jersey
description: Pierre "Peb" Bellocq died Nov. 12 just 13 days from his 100th birthday. His insightful, humorous, and poignant cartoons and caricatures have attracted acclaim and honors internationally for more than 70 years.

title_en: Cowans Trains 1,000th Winner
description: With a victory in the fifth race Nov. 11 with Michael Foster's Blue Tail Fly at Mahoning Valley Race Course, trainer William D. Cowans reaches the 1,000-win milestone.

title_en: T O Elvis Big Mover in World's Best Racehorse Rankings
description: Fast-finishing Breeders' Cup Sprint winner (G1) T O Elvis is one of the big movers in the latest edition of the Longines World's Best Racehorse Rankings for 2026, along with another Japan-based runner in Danon Decile.

title_en: Triple Crown Nominations Scrapped in Favor of TCS Noms
description: Owners wishing to nominate horses to next year's Kentucky Derby and Belmont Stakes (both G1) will do so by nominating to CDI and NYRA's Thoroughbred Championship Series to launch in 2027, as opposed to nominating to the Triple Crown.

title_en: Buick Eyeing International Jockeys' Championship Crown
description: There are few major prizes that elude William Buick, but the International Jockeys' Championship at Happy Valley Racecourse is one of them. He comes into his sixth IJC in excellent form.

title_en: Melbourne Cup Carnival Draws Largest Crowds Since 2017
description: The 2026 Melbourne Cup Carnival attracted 307,889 racegoers to Flemington across four days, the largest Carnival attendance since 2017.

title_en: New Names, Branding for Alberta's Class A Racetracks
description: Highfield Investment Group announced Nov. 12 the launch of Chinook Downs Racetrack in Calgary and Northern Mile Racetrack in Edmonton, alongside the introduction of Spire Casino at both destinations. They replace the former Century tracks.

title_en: New Zealand Bloodstock Tabs McMahon, Hill
description: Auction house New Zealand Bloodstock has appointed Mike McMahon and Jamie Hill as American-based sale representatives.

title_en: Handicapping: How Auction Prices Relate to Race Results
description: The latest edition of the Odds and Trends column with J. Keeler Johnson explores how auction prices relate to on-track results.

title_en: Keeneland November Sale Ends With Record Average
description: The Keeneland November Breeding Stock Sale concluded Nov. 11 with a brisk market. A total of 2,025 horses changed hands for $253,091,700, including post-ring sales, a 2.9% jump from last year's $246,042,400 total for 1,986 head.

title_en: Walmac Releases 2027 Stud Fees, Led by Pappacap
description: Pappacap, who will stand for $12,500, is followed by the farm's newest addition in grade 1 winner Stronghold, who will stand his initial season at stud for $10,000.

title_en: Record November Momentum Fuels Keeneland HORA Sale
description: Following its strong November Breeding Stock Sale, Keeneland looks to maintain that momentum with the Nov. 12 November Horses of Racing Age Sale. The single-session auction features a catalog of 87 horses of racing age, with many in top form.

title_en: Texas 2-Year-Olds in Training Sale Set for March 31
description: The 2027 Texas 2-Year-Olds in Training Sale will be held March 31 at the Mary Ruyle Sales Pavilion at Lone Star Park in Grand Prairie, Texas.

title_en: Victory Achieved Looks to Double Up in Kennedy Road
description: Victory Achieved lived up to his name by taking the Oct. 3 Nearctic Stakes (G2T) in a 6-furlong contest on turf at Woodbine. Now, he sprints 6 furlongs on Woodbine's Tapeta main track in the Nov. 14 Kennedy Road Stakes (G2).

title_en: Elite Cast Assembles for Bahrain International Trophy
description: The Nov. 13 Bahrain International Trophy (G1) has attracted a starry cast for its first incarnation as a group 1 race, including Wimbledon Hawkeye, last year's winner Royal Champion, and dual Derby winner Lambourn.

title_en: Racing Memorabilia On Offer at The Inside Track Auction
description: Budds and Weatherbys bring 591 lots of racing history to the National Horse Racing Museum Nov. 18 in Newmarket for The Inside Track, a major auction spanning more than 300 years of the sport.

title_en: First-Year Trainer Cazares Aims High in Claiming Crown
description: Starting his training career this year at 22, a young Rene Cazares Jr. hopes the Nov. 14 Claiming Crown at Churchill Downs will be his first of many big events.

title_en: Sporting Art Auction to Offer Unique Looks at Racing
description: Thoroughbreds, racing scenes, landscapes—and even a hippopotamus—are among the attractions at this year's 14th annual Sporting Art Auction.

title_en: Bacio a Success Story for Gladwells
description: Just days after Bacio's victory in the Breeders' Cup Turf Sprint (G1T), Torie and Jimbo Gladwell of Top Line Sales were already back to work.

title_en: Talamo Excited for His Return to Race Riding
description: Nearly two decades after launching his career with a historic riding title at Fair Grounds, Joe Talamo is returning to the saddle with a fresh perspective and the same work ethic that helped establish him among the nation's leading riders.

title_en: FOX Sports Among Networks to Televise Bahrain Group 1
description: The $1.5 million Bahrain International Trophy (G1) will be broadcast around the world Nov. 13, with 25 networks delivering coverage across more than 130 territories, including FOX Sports in the United States.

title_en: Erik Asmussen, Franco Share Jockey of the Week Honors
description: Erik Asmussen and Manny Franco tie in voting for Jockey of the Week.

title_en: Breeders' Cup Victress Splendora Retired From Racing
description: Splendora, winner of the 2025 Breeders' Cup Filly and Mare Sprint (G1), has been retired from racing, according to an Instagram post from Boyd Racing, which campaigned the 5-year-old mare.

title_en: Reef Runner on the Mend at Gulfstream Park
description: After being sidelined with a soft tissue injury this summer, Alex and JoAnn Lieblong's grade 1-winning homebred Reef Runner has rejoined David Fawkes' Gulfstream Park barn, although his resumption of training is still a bit away.

title_en: Santamaria's Breakout Year Culminates in Claiming Crown
description: Carlos Santamaria, who is having a career year after starting his own stable from scratch in late 2022, has his first Claiming Crown in Workman Ranch's Global Sensation in the $125,000 Rapid Transit at 7 furlongs.

title_en: Meeks Earns Juan Saez Leading Apprentice Jockey Award
description: Following a strong racing season from start to finish, apprentice jockey Micah Meeks was honored with the 13th annual Juan Saez Leading Apprentice Jockey Award during closing week of the 2026 racing season at Horseshoe Indianapolis.

description: A decade after beginning his career with a zero-horse stable, Matt Shirer's growing success has led to three starters in the Nov. 14 Claiming Crown at Churchill Downs.

description: Trainer Matt Shirer discusses his three entrants for the Nov. 14 Claiming Crown at Churchill Downs: Talkin in Cursive ($100,000 Empress), Five o' Somewhere ($125,000 Rapid Transit), and Light the Way ($175,000 Emerald).

title_en: Racing's 'Backbone' Horses Compete in Claiming Crown
description: The backbone of the racing industry, claiming horses, compete in their own championship event Nov. 14 when $1.2 million in purses is on the line at Churchill Downs during the Claiming Crown.

title_en: Brown's Barrel Roll, Bletchley Emerge As Hot Prospects

description: Star sprinter Almeraq and 2025 Prix Maurice de Gheest (G1) scorer Sajir will begin life at Beech House Stud in Newmarket, where Baaeed leads the roster and will stand for an unchanged figure.

description: Two-time grade 1 winner Englishman has been retired to Lane's End. He will stand for $50,000 in 2027 at the farm near Versailles, Ky.
